notes.note: Reviewed the exact S3 source delta against the Project, API, configuration, and trust claims. The client SDK evaluates from inside the server bundle on the first list or read. The selected profile, feature default, source bounds and API remain the same. After module load the service checks current authority before SDK dispatch and retains the HTTP and response checks. Local tests cover the two timing cases, SDK serialization and guest/admin routing, with no real AWS qualification.
